name: 🍝 Spinach & Cottage Cheese Baked Pasta
tagline: A lazy lasagna: creamy, cheesy, high-protein baked pasta with spinach hiding in plain sight.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Boil the pasta 2 minutes less than the box says. Drain.
While it boils, cook the garlic in the oil 30 seconds, add the spinach and stir until wilted.
In a big bowl mix the cottage cheese, egg, half the parmesan, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper.
Fold in the spinach, the pasta, 2 cups marinara and 1 cup mozzarella.
Spread in a 9×13. Spoon the rest of the sauce on top, then the last mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbly; broil 2 minutes for brown spots. Rest 5 minutes.

kid_jobs.job: Crack the egg into the cottage cheese and stir
Spread it in the dish and add the cheese on top
Set out parmesan for the table

chef_tip: Undercook the pasta by 2 minutes. It finishes in the oven soaking up sauce, so it ends up just right instead of mushy.
make_ahead: Assemble a day ahead (fridge, covered); bake 30 minutes.
leftovers: Reheats better than it starts. Perfect lunch.
swaps: Barilla Protein+ pasta for even more protein
serve_with: Spring mix with Italian dressing, garlic toast
heads_up: Oven to 400°F and the pasta water on.

game_plan.what: Oven to 400°F. Pasta water on to boil.
Pasta in. Wilt the spinach with garlic. Kids mix the cheese filling.
Drain. Kids fold it all together and fill the 9×13.
Into the oven for 20 min, then 2 min under the broiler.
Serve with a salad or garlic toast.
